title: EEGDash Corpus: A Training-Ready Public Corpus for EEG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models for electroencephalography (EEG) are pretrained on tens of thousands of hours of recordings, and their accuracy grows with that amount. Such data is hard to assemble. The largest sources are clinical archives that cannot be redistributed, and the public sources are spread over several archives, file formats, and licences. We release eegdash-corpus-v0, a training-ready corpus of 77 public EEG datasets, as the gated Hugging Face dataset EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0 with the SHA-256 of every file. REVE, the largest published EEG foundation model, names 89 datasets as its pretraining corpus. Twelve cannot be redistributed: four clinical archives that hold 82% of its hours, and eight under no-derivatives licences. The corpus holds the 76 others that REVE's sampling rate allows and one more from REVE's release card: 77 datasets, 14,075 hours from 7,272 subjects, 5.0 million 10-second samples and 6.21 billion tokens per epoch. Ev

translated_title: EEGDash语料库：面向脑电（EEG）基础模型的即用型公开训练语料库
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型通常在数万小时的记录数据上进行预训练，且其准确率随数据量的增加而提升。然而，这类数据难以汇集：规模最大的数据来源是无法重新分发的临床档案库，而公开数据源则分散在多个档案库、文件格式和许可证之中。我们发布了eegdash-corpus-v0，这是一个包含77个公开EEG数据集、可直接用于训练的语料库，以受限访问的Hugging Face数据集形式（EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0）发布，并为每个文件提供了SHA-256校验值。REVE是目前已发表的规模最大的EEG基础模型，其列出了89个数据集作为预训练语料，但其中12个无法重新分发：四个临床档案库（占其总时长的82%）以及八个受禁止衍生条款许可证约束的数据集。本语料库收录了REVE采样率所允许的其余76个数据集，以及来自REVE发布说明的另一个数据集：共计77个数据集、来自7,272名受试者的14,075小时数据、500万个10秒样本，每个训练周期包含62.1亿个token。
tldr: 该论文发布了首个即用型EEG基础模型公开训练语料库eegdash-corpus-v0，汇集了77个可合法再分发的公开数据集（涵盖7,272名受试者的14,075小时数据），解决了临床档案无法再分发、公开数据分散且格式不一导致难以汇集的核心问题。
